title: sideritis nervosa
intro: Sideritis nervosa, commonly known as White Sage, is a perennial plant native to the Mediterranean region. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Sideritis nervosa include its ability to act as an antispasmodic, reducing muscle spasms and cramps, and its antihistaminic properties, which can alleviate allergic reactions. The bioactive constituents of Sideritis nervosa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
